rules.name: cash-refresh-21-volume-and-mapping-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT value_date,settlement_date, (value_date=:valueDate::date AND settlement_date=:cob::date) AS dates_match, (:prevCob::date=coalesce((SELECT settlement_date FROM opera.vdate_sdate_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND value_date=:cob), (SELECT max(cob_date) FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=:bu AND cob_date<:cob))) AS previous_date_matches, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.client_cash_account_balance_table b WHERE b.tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(b.business_unit))=:bu AND b.cob_date=:prevCob) AS previous_balance_rows FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=:bu

WITH cb_refresh_input AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT r.tenant_id, r.business_unit, r.trade_id, r.value_date, r.settlement_date, r.instrument, r.subportfolio, r.product_code, r.derivative_type, r.original_lots, r.active_lots, r.currency, r.transaction_date, r.maturity_date, r.contract_month, r.future_expiry, r.counterparty_parent, CASE WHEN upper(trim(r.counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(r.derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc' THEN 'SIP' ELSE r.client_code END AS client_code, r.contract_number, r.original_premium, r.lot_mult, r.curr_mult, r.mult_factor, r.nc_factor, r.fx_nc_factor, r.netting_date, r.netting_status, r.opt_periodicity, r.is_premium_paid, r.fixing_date, r.settle_price, r.netted_lots FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant, :bu) r WHERE r.tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(r.business_unit))=:bu AND ((nullif(trim(r.client_code),'') IS NOT NULL AND lower(trim(r.client_code))<>'null') OR (upper(trim(r.counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(r.derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc')) ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cb_refresh_input) AS bu_report_rows, count(*) AS java_report_rows, count(DISTINCT client_code) AS client_sheet_count_upper, (SELECT count(*) FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant) AS spot_mapping_rows, coalesce(sum(octet_length(to_jsonb(r)::text)),0) AS json_payload_bytes, coalesce(max(octet_length(to_jsonb(r)::text)),0) AS largest_json_row_bytes, count(*)*30 AS raw_data_cells, count(*)*60+30*(count(DISTINCT client_code)+1) AS workbook_cells_upper, count(*)>1048575 AS exceeds_excel_sheet_limit, count(*) FILTER(WHERE value_date IS DISTINCT FROM :valueDate::date OR settlement_date IS DISTINCT FROM :cob::date) AS date_mismatch_rows FROM cb_refresh_input r WHERE (:clientFilter='' OR upper(trim(r.client_code))=upper(trim(:clientFilter))) AND (:currencyFilter='' OR upper(trim(r.currency))=upper(trim(:currencyFilter)))

WITH cb_refresh_input AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT r.tenant_id, r.business_unit, r.trade_id, r.value_date, r.settlement_date, r.instrument, r.subportfolio, r.product_code, r.derivative_type, r.original_lots, r.active_lots, r.currency, r.transaction_date, r.maturity_date, r.contract_month, r.future_expiry, r.counterparty_parent, CASE WHEN upper(trim(r.counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(r.derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc' THEN 'SIP' ELSE r.client_code END AS client_code, r.contract_number, r.original_premium, r.lot_mult, r.curr_mult, r.mult_factor, r.nc_factor, r.fx_nc_factor, r.netting_date, r.netting_status, r.opt_periodicity, r.is_premium_paid, r.fixing_date, r.settle_price, r.netted_lots FROM opera.fn_cash_balance_report_for_scope(:tenant, :bu) r WHERE r.tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(r.business_unit))=:bu AND ((nullif(trim(r.client_code),'') IS NOT NULL AND lower(trim(r.client_code))<>'null') OR (upper(trim(r.counterparty_parent))='SIPH' AND lower(trim(r.derivative_type))='avg_swap_cc')) ) , currencies AS (SELECT DISTINCT upper(trim(currency)) AS currency FROM cb_refresh_input UNION SELECT 'USD'), old_mapping AS ( SELECT upper(trim(currency)) AS currency, upper(trim(quantotype)) AS quantotype FROM opera.cash_balance_currency_mapping_view WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND upper(trim(business_unit))=:bu), new_mapping AS (SELECT upper(trim(currency)) AS currency,upper(trim(quantotype)) AS quantotype FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id=:tenant) SELECT c.currency, o.quantotype AS current_java_quantotype, n.quantotype AS candidate_quantotype, (SELECT count(*) FROM old_mapping x WHERE x.currency=c.currency) AS current_mapping_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM new_mapping x WHERE x.currency=c.currency) AS spot_mapping_rows, (o.quantotype IS DISTINCT FROM n.quantotype) AS differs, CASE WHEN o.quantotype='DIVISION' THEN 'DIVISION' ELSE 'MULTIPLICATION' END AS current_effective_operation, CASE WHEN n.quantotype='DIVISION' THEN 'DIVISION' ELSE 'MULTIPLICATION' END AS candidate_effective_operation, ((o.quantotype='DIVISION') IS TRUE) IS DISTINCT FROM ((n.quantotype='DIVISION') IS TRUE) AS changes_operation FROM currencies c LEFT JOIN old_mapping o USING(currency) LEFT JOIN new_mapping n USING(currency) ORDER BY c.currency

expect.reason: pin the run to the actual valuation context
an empty run cannot prove report sizing
the new refresh requires a nonempty spot mapping
investigate intentional mapping differences before accepting parity
